title: A Ramanujan Pell K3 Surface and Cube Representations
summary: A negative Pell equation produces positive integers with $a_n^3+b_n^3+c_n^3=561N_n^3+(-1)^{n+1}$. We classify all positive solutions satisfying the natural linear constraints of the construction and prove an exact pairwise coprimality law, with exceptional factor $137$ in one class modulo $68$. The associated sextic $K=(1-13u+26u^2)^3+(6+182u^2)^3$ defines an elliptic K3 surface with six type-IV fibres.
